notes.title: The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods Is Announced!
notes.content:
Greetings,

We're happy to announce that The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods, a new immersive first-person action title, will be released on Steam and PlayStation 5 platforms!

https://i.imgur.com/b1nH6M9.gif

While we don't have a release date to share yet, we're working hard to create a unique yet familiar immersive sim experience for all fans of the genre! Additionally, we're also working on co-op support for the story playthrough. To address any concerns, the game will be fully playable solo, while co-op support being optional for those who want to experience the story with a friend in a more fun and chaotic way!
